_doc: Attribute families that move from one scalar to a {desktop, tablet, mobile} object (footer framework batch, FW-F). A block.json attribute whose name matches a pattern and whose type is still a scalar is a migration target (migrate-scalar-tier.py); once it is type object it is an old-shape rule: any saved scalar value of it is a defect (find-scalar-tier-attrs.py). Rules cover an object-typed block.json attribute that matches a family or is listed in `migrated` (attributes moved from scalar by earlier batches, with their block).
